Belirli bir IP adresinden ya da aralığın: From a specific IP address or range
Eski adresten yapılacak yeni bağlantılar: New connections from the old address are rejected; connections that are already open continue until they close.
Güvenlik duvarında {port} portu kapalı;: Port {port} is closed in the firewall; after enabling this setting you need to open it to connect from outside.
Port {port} is closed in the firewall; it must be opened before outside connections can reach the server.
İnternetteki herkes bu kullanıcıyla bağl: Anyone on the internet can try to connect as this user; your password is the only protection. Enter a specific IP address if you can.
MariaDB uzak bağlantıda TLS zorunlu kılm: MariaDB does not require TLS for remote connections; for sensitive data use TLS in the client or restrict the address.
Sunucuda TLS kapalı; uzak bağlantılar şi: TLS is off on the server; remote connections are unencrypted. Turning on ssl in PostgreSQL is recommended.
Sunucuda uzaktan bağlantı kapalı; yöneti: Remote connections are disabled on the server; an administrator needs to enable them.
Remote connections are disabled on the server; an administrator needs to enable them. The address is saved and takes effect once the setting is enabled.
Şimdi yalnızca bu sunucudan bağlanılabil: Right now only this server can connect. Users with a remote address cannot connect from outside until this setting is enabled.
Tek bir IP adresi ya da CIDR aralığı (20: A single IP address or a CIDR range (203.0.113.0/24). To connect from outside, the database port must also be open in the firewall.
Veritabanı sunucusu yeniden başlatılır,: The database server is restarted and open connections are dropped. The server starts listening on external addresses too; you choose where each user may connect from in the user rows.

The database server is restarted and open connections are dropped. The server accepts connections from this machine only; users' saved remote addresses are kept and apply again when the setting is re-enabled.
